# FabricOS

> FabricOS is a configurable, AI-powered operating system for institutions. It connects people, roles, departments, workflows, information and AI agents in one permission-checked workspace, so work moves forward while people stay in control.

Tagline: Your institution. Your workflows. Your AI.

This file is optional documentation for AI agents and crawlers. Nothing here guarantees search ranking or citation. If this file and a public page disagree, the page is correct.

## Who it is for
- Built and running today for schools and colleges (education and training).
- Other sectors (professional institutes, associations, service organisations, multi-team businesses) are configuration conversations: the same core of roles, workflows, approvals and AI agents is configured with the institution. FabricOS does not claim a finished product for every industry.

## Capabilities (education, available today)
- Admissions, attendance, fees and receipts, exams and results, assignments, school website CMS, notifications.
- Role-scoped workspaces for leaders, administrators, teachers, students and parents.
- Workflows with defined steps (draft, review, approve, publish); corrections add a new version instead of overwriting history.
- AI agents answer questions, prepare drafts and propose actions within the permissions of the person asking. A person approves anything that changes a record.
- AI output is a suggestion a person saves or approves. AI never writes marks, payments, access or welfare decisions.
- Each institution sets an AI policy: cloud models or local-only processing.
- Attention signals and forecasts across modules; these need human approval before anything changes.
- Multi-tenant isolation with row-level security; append-only audit log of sensitive actions.
- Fee payments run through Razorpay in test mode only.
- Email and WhatsApp notifications are simulated until a channel is configured.

## Not available
AI credits or bring-your-own-key, voice, what-if simulation, marketplace purchasing, native mobile apps (the web app works in a mobile browser).

## Not for crawling
Signed-in app routes, /api, /login, /start, /select, /portal, /platform. See /robots.txt.
